blocks.text: OLLY Ultra Strength Hair Softgels deliver a premium blend of essential Vitamins and Minerals for healthy hair from within.*A few highlights: Biotin helps your body metabolize fats and protein, and supports healthy hair and nails. A blend of key vitamins and minerals helps to support hair follicle health.* Plus Keratin and Amla, a botanical extract used for centuries in Ayuverdic tradition. For a delightful twist, these softgels have a hint of strawberry flavor. OLLY Ultra Strength softgels are gluten free, sugar free and easy to swallow. Don’t let their size fool you—these little softgels go big on benefits. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
